chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Camp Nou, June 2001. Two-all, last minute. Barcelona must win. De Boer chips it forward. Rivaldo chests it up... overhead kick! Bottom corner!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Slow motion. His chest is soft, like a pillow. It cushions the ball and pops it up. Then he falls back and swings his leg over his head.

chapters.label: Behind the goal
chapters.text: Cañizares dives, but it swerves past him. Three-two! A hat-trick, and a Champions League place!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn. A soft first touch sets up your next move. Overhead kicks? Only practise on soft mats, with a coach.
